title: Privacy & legal
intro: How we collect, use, and protect information on this website.

sections.heading: Your privacy is critically important to us.
sections.body: Fangled Tech International © D.B.A. Fangled Group is located in Moreland Hills, Ohio, and is reachable by email at info@fangledtech.com and telephone at (888) 427-5609. It is Fangled Tech’s policy to respect your privacy regarding any information we may collect while operating our website. This Privacy Policy applies to fangledtech.com (hereinafter, “us”, “we”, or “fangledgroup.com”). We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting personally identifiable information you may provide us through the Website. We have adopted this privacy policy to explain what information may be collected on our Website, how we use this information, and under what circumstances we may disclose the information to third parties.

sections.heading: Website Visitors
sections.body: Like most website operators, Fangled Tech International © collects non-personally-identifying information of the sort that web browsers and servers typically make available, such as browser type, language preference, referring site, and the date and time of each visitor request. Fangled Group also collects potentially personally-identifying information like IP addresses for logged in users and for users leaving comments.

sections.heading: Gathering of Personally-Identifying Information
sections.body: Certain visitors to Fangled Group’s websites choose to interact with Fangled Group in ways that require us to gather personally-identifying information. The amount and type of information that Fangled Group gathers depends on the nature of the interaction. For example, we ask visitors who sign up for communications to provide a name and email address.

sections.heading: Security
sections.body: The security of your Personal Information is important to us, but remember that no method of transmission over the Internet, or method of electronic storage is 100% secure. While we strive to use commercially acceptable means to protect your Personal Information, we cannot guarantee its absolute security.

sections.heading: Links To External Sites
sections.body: Our Service may contain links to external sites that are not operated by us. If you click on a third party link, you will be directed to that third party’s site. We strongly advise you to review the Privacy Policy and terms and conditions of every site you visit.

sections.heading: Aggregated Statistics
sections.body: Fangled Tech International © may collect statistics about the behavior of visitors to its website. Fangled Tech International © may display this information publicly or provide it to others. However, Fangled Tech does not disclose your personally-identifying information.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: To enrich and perfect your online experience, Fangled Tech International © uses “Cookies”, similar technologies and services provided by others to display personalized content, appropriate advertising and store your preferences on your computer.

sections.heading: Privacy Policy Changes
sections.body: Although most changes are likely to be minor, Fangled Group may change its Privacy Policy from time to time, and in Fangled Tech’s sole discretion. Fangled Tech encourages visitors to frequently check this page for any changes to its Privacy Policy. Your continued use of this site after any change in this Privacy Policy will constitute your acceptance of such change.
